record.question: Coil arrays are used in MRI to:
options: To improve signal reception and image quality
record.explanation: Official final key: A — To improve signal reception and image quality. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 8, printed Q34. Source limitation: The stem does not specify whether it asks the fundamental function of array coils or their parallel-imaging benefit; both offered benefits can be correct. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
